_comment: Gallery index — NOT registry-schema-validated (this file's shape isn't a Registry, it's a list-of-lists). Each entry's `file` is fetched relative to this directory (public/lists/) when a Gallery card is opened.

lists.name: Trust Wallet SDUI Showcase
lists.description: Hand-authored tokens demonstrating the full SDUI widget/action vocabulary — mint/redeem banners, staking, notices — alongside real ETH, WETH, and Trust Wallet Token.

lists.name: Uniswap Labs Default
lists.description: Real, well-known Ethereum tokens borrowed from Uniswap's official default token list — real addresses, real logos, minimal styling. Shows what importing an existing real-world token list looks like.

lists.name: Aegis Super List
lists.description: 46 real tokens across Ethereum, BSC and TRON, sourced from the Aegis Platform's own network whitelists. Every contract address, decimals value and logo was verified live on-chain before shipping — including catching Binance-Peg USDT/USDC's 18-decimal BSC contracts (vs 6 on Ethereum).

lists.name: Paras — Top Stablecoins
lists.description: 22 top stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI, USDe, PYUSD, TUSD, EURC, USDP, FRAX, FDUSD, USD1) across Ethereum, BSC, Tron and Solana, sourced from Pharos Watch. Every contract/mint was independently re-verified live (decimals + logo) before shipping.
